VALIDITY NOTE: two other documents opened in this pass give a shorter figure for the FERC-jurisdictional mainline alone -- the CEQA 1994 filing and the TC Energy Xpress fact sheet both say the interstate line runs 'approximately 229 miles' from Malin, OR to the Wadsworth, NV area, while the fact sheet separately states 'The 300-mile system, which includes associated laterals, has a current capacity of approximately 230 MMcf/d' (i.e. 229 mi mainline + ~70-76 mi of laterals = ~300-305 mi total). Flagging per contract for a validity/spec check given the two ways this pipeline's length gets reported.
